scripts.deploy: pnpm client:build && pnpm db:migrate:production && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env local
scripts.test:backend: node --experimental-strip-types --test src/auth-policy.test.ts src/car-policy.test.ts src/component-policy.test.ts src/drive-session-policy.test.ts src/maintenance-policy.test.ts src/service-policy.test.ts src/photo-policy.test.ts src/setup-policy.test.ts
scripts.check:client: pnpm --dir client build && pnpm --dir client exec ng test --watch=false --no-progress
